vocabulary.meaning_en: a sentence form where the object of the action becomes the subject (The house was built.)
vocabulary.example: "The car was washed" is in the passive voice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sentence form where the subject does the action (James wrote the message.)
vocabulary.example: "Ali washed the car" is in the active voice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the third form of a verb (written, built, stolen)
the person or thing that receives the action
vocabulary.example: In "I read the book", the book is the object.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person or thing that the sentence is about (usually before the verb)
vocabulary.example: In "The book was read", the book is the subject.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to change or have an effect on something
to invent or create an idea
vocabulary.example: This lesson was thought up by Mr. E.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take something that is not yours
a small case for money and cards
vocabulary.example: I left my wallet at home.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to look at something carefully to judge it
to make bad news easier to hear
vocabulary.example: He smiled to soften the blow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clear and straight, saying things openly
vocabulary.example: The active voice is more direct.

fine_lines.title: active vs passive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المبني للمعلوم يركز على من قام بالفعل وهو أكثر حيوية ومباشرة. المبني للمجهول يركز على الشيء الذي وقع عليه الفعل، ونستخدمه عندما لا نعرف الفاعل أو لا يهمنا، أو لتخفيف خبر سيئ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Active focuses on who does the action; it is more lively and direct. Passive focuses on the thing that receives the action; use it when we don't know or don't care who did it, or to soften bad news.

fine_lines.title: was written vs wrote
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wrote ماضٍ بسيط مبني للمعلوم. was written مبني للمجهول (be + التصريف الثالث).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Wrote is active past simple. Was written is passive (be + past participle).

expressions.meaning_en: Someone stole my wallet (we don't know who).
expressions.example: I can't pay. My wallet was stolen.

expressions.phrase: The house was built 20 years ago.
expressions.meaning_en: We don't know who built it.
expressions.example: This house was built 20 years ago.

expressions.meaning_en: A soft, polite way to give news about someone's work.
expressions.example: Your work has been reviewed, and some changes are needed.

expressions.meaning_en: Shows who did the action in a passive sentence.
expressions.example: This lesson was thought up by Mr. E.

grammar.title: When do we use the passive?
grammar.explanation_ar: (1) لا نعرف من قام بالفعل. (2) لا يهمنا من قام به. (3) نريد التركيز على الشيء الذي تأثر بالفعل. (4) لتخفيف خبر سيئ (soften the blow).
grammar.explanation_en: (1) We don't know who did it. (2) We don't care who did it. (3) We want to focus on the thing affected. (4) To soften bad news.
examples: The house was built 20 years ago. (don't know)
My wallet was stolen. (don't care who)

grammar.title: Form: subject + be + past participle
grammar.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول = فعل be (بالزمن المناسب) + التصريف الثالث. المضارع: is/am/are + PP. الماضي: was/were + PP. المستقبل: will be + PP. المضارع التام: has/have been + PP.
grammar.explanation_en: Passive = be (in the right tense) + past participle. Present: is/am/are + PP. Past: was/were + PP. Future: will be + PP. Present perfect: has/have been + PP.
examples: The results will be sent tomorrow.
This lesson has been thought up by me.

grammar.title: Active to passive
grammar.explanation_ar: المفعول به في الجملة المعلومة يصبح فاعلًا في الجملة المجهولة. يمكن ذكر الفاعل الأصلي بعد by أو حذفه.
grammar.explanation_en: The object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence. You can add the doer after by, or leave it out.
examples: Passive: This message was written by James.

questions.question: Make it passive: "James wrote this message."
choices: This message is write by James.
This message was written by James.
questions.explanation_en: The object becomes the subject + was written.

questions.question: Why do we use the passive in "The house was built 20 years ago"?
choices: Because the house is a person.
We don't know who built it.
questions.explanation_en: We don't know who built it.

questions.question: Which voice is usually more lively and direct?
questions.explanation_en: Active is more lively and direct.

questions.question: In the passive, the doer comes after ___.
"Soften the blow" means ___.
choices: make bad news easier to hear
questions.explanation_en: Make bad news easier to hear.
